Author: colliexiv
Name: JP/EN Chat
Description:
Shows chat in a two-pane window with the original Japanese on the left and a streamed English translation on the right, aligned row by row.
Type English into the game's chat box to get a Japanese translation (polite, casual, cool or your own persona) with a word-by-word breakdown and back-translation in a popup, confirm, and send.
Translation uses your own OpenRouter or Claude API key (chat lines in the channels you enable, with a little game context, are sent to the provider you choose). Early release.
Punchline: Two-pane JP/EN chat translation for English players on Japanese data centers.
